inference_rules: Do not add Omdia's music, news, podcast and professional-video categories as they can overlap, and have incomplete public coding definitions.
Shorts share of new uploaded objects is not Shorts share of viewer watch time or creative labor.
Top 1% of videos accounting for 91% of watch time in an analyst study is not a top 1% of creators' revenue, and may not map to individual channels.
Do not compare Omdia's 2025 cumulative video stock with current 2026 upload volume as if they were the same reporting period.
NRG samples ages 14–29 and 14–44 are separate question-specific population frames and must not be pooled into a single denominator.
Self-described niche viewing can overlap with other content groups. Attitude agreement is not a verified niche unique audience count.
Neither research firm provided a representative platform-wide newcomer creator income, cash production cost or zero-earner sample.
Do not attempt user-level profiling or infer any child's attributes or interests from study aggregate data.

limitations: March 31 2025 view-count rule changed Shorts start-based public views, crossing the February 2025 and February 2026 endpoints; do not infer equivalent real attention increase.
August 24 2026 all-format change occurred after both February comparison points; do not misattribute this vendor study's view changes to that later rule.
Selected connected accounts are neither a probability sample of all YouTube accounts nor a fixed account panel verified for both months.
Per-post view events, average viewing duration, feed-derived organic view event share and creator profit have incompatible denominators.
There is no standard conversion between raw prechange views and postchange Shorts engaged views in this source, and no evidence that higher reported view counts caused creator cash earnings.
